messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @oncall - policy-engine reported runtime exception in smart-routing evaluator (service=policy-engine, severity=critical). Creating incident INC-2026-342. root ts=1776001110

Alex G: ack. I'm oncall for infra today, looking. Which customers are impacted? any error spikes?

Priya K: seeing increased 5xx + timeouts for routing requests to model variants in eu-west. Dash shows fallback loop: requests keep retrying policies and eventually land on an expensive large-variant -> high latency. Impacting ~8 customers, some dedicatee tenants experiencing request failures.

Samir P: I pulled logs from policy-engine. There's a panic in the expr evaluator: "panic: invalid expression token at position 23". stack excerpt:```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
main.evaluateExpr
	gopath/src/redwood/policy/eval.go:214
main.handleRequest
	gopath/src/redwood/policy/handler.go:98
```
The rule that triggered looks like it has a malformed conditional.

Maria T: can you paste the rule? if it's a parsing error we should disable policy evaluation quickly. Temporary mitigation: flip smart-routing to routing-mode=static-default or push a global override policy that routes everything to default-model-1.

Samir P: here's the rule fragment I found in the active policy payload:```
- name: eu_high_priority
  when: region == 'eu-west && customer.tier == "enterprise"
  then: route model_variant: "opt-4x"
```
notice the missing closing quote before && - looks like an accidental edit during an A/B rollout. That causes parser to crash.

Chloe R: ok immediate plan: 1) disable policy evaluation on control-plane for the affected policy id (policy-id=pol_87320) 2) apply global override to route to default-model-1 3) purge policy cache on runtime nodes. I'll run commands now.

Chloe R: running:```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/policies/pol_87320/disable" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_KEY"
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/api/routing/override" -d '{"target":"default-model-1","reason":"incident fallback"}'
```
(issued at 1776001294)

incident-bot: Action taken: policy pol_87320 disabled by Chloe R (cmd executed). Override routing set to default-model-1. Notifying runtimes to clear policy cache.

Priya K: after disable, error rate dropped immediately and p50 latency returned to baseline in eu-west. Customer-facing errors stopped for most affected tenants. A couple of in-flight requests still failed while caches cleared.

Alex G: good. Samir, can you push a hotfix to reject malformed policy updates at control-plane input validation? This should never make the runtime panic.

Samir P: yes, I'll open a PR after we stabilise. For now, I'll add a safeguard: catch parse errors and return a 422 instead of crashing.

Maria T: followup mitigation for production: add a canary check in the policy deploy pipeline that syntactically validates expressions before activation.

Support Bot: Notifying affected customers: email batch queued for tenants: acme, globex, trillem. Status page updated to "degraded - routing failures".

Alex G: cost note: because the fallback routed traffic onto default-model-1 (a larger variant for some keys), infra costs spiked ~12% for the window. Track billing impact and include in postmortem.

Chloe R: handing off to morning oncall. I'm leaving the override in place until we have a validated policy pushed. Morning team please own rollback validation and postmortem. Link to runbook: https://internal/runbooks/policy-engine-incident.

Priya K: adding monitoring TODOs: 1) alert on policy-engine parse errors > 1/min 2) alert on routing fallback rate > 5% for >5m 3) dashboard for model-variant churn.

Samir P: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/policy-engine/pulls/942 - adds safe parse + better error returns. Will coordinate with Maria for canary.

Maria T: I'll coordinate canary deploy of fixed validator to control-plane, then we can re-enable the policy after validation. ETA 2h.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-342 status: mitigated. severity: high -> degraded. Actions logged. Postmortem required.

Alex G: Thanks team. Chloe, leaving incident-owner tag to @Chloe for handoff. Morning please run the playbook: verify PR, re-enable policy with validation, confirm no parser regressions, and publish postmortem within 48h.

Chloe R: acknowledged. I'm posting a short incident summary to #postmortems and will create the ticket. Final note: we must add stronger validation in the UI too (prevent accidental malformed edits). :thumbsup:
